text:
marina: Heads-up: scheduling a coordinated release tonight 20:30 PDT / 03:30 UTC. Targets: api v3.3.0, runtime v10.0.1 (quant+kernel tweak), router v1.6.2 (split routing table), console v2.1.0. Need ordering, pin strategy, and smoke tests.

josh: Can we avoid a simultaneous router/console schema flip? last time console had a delayed build and we had transient 502s.

rachel: console has a compatibility flag `allow-mixed-headers` in 2.1.0 we can keep on. If router drops legacy headers we must flip console first.

marina: My proposed order: API -> Router -> Runtime -> Console. Reason: router must be able to route traffic to runtime variants and API change is minimal. But open to discussion.

josh: Concern: runtime v10 changes KV layout. If router points traffic to new runtime before API can gate, we risk cache miss amplification. Can API gate based on `x-runtime-variant` header? deploy-bot can inject.

rachel: Yes API supports header gating. Also we can publish a temporary route rule that pins 0.5% of routes to new runtime for a smoke run.

deploy-bot: Proposed waves (created by @marina):
- wave-1 api v3.3.0 2024-04-12 03:30 UTC — canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% (15m holds)
- wave-2 router v1.6.2 03:50 UTC — `allow-legacy-headers=true` for 30m, routing-table split gradual (10s fanout)
- wave-3 runtime v10.0.1 04:10 UTC — gated via header `x-runtime-variant: v10` (canary 1% -> 10%)
- wave-4 console v2.1.0 04:30 UTC — feature gated, UI rollout controlled by flag

deploy-bot: Rollback handlers: `deployctl rollback api --to previous`, `deployctl rollback router --to previous`, `deployctl rollback runtime --to previous`, `deployctl rollback console --to previous`.

ops-runbook-bot: Auto-pause triggers (examples):
```
api_p95_latency > 800ms for 5m
api_5xx_rate > 0.8% for 3m
router_header_drop > 10/min
runtime_kernel_oom > 0 in 2 nodes within 5m
console_js_errors > 5% of UI sessions in 10m
```
If an auto-pause happens, the wave will pause and ops paging begins. If severe, rollback the last service changed.

marina: Action owners: I'll own overall orchestration and release notes. Josh you own runtime rollout + kernel telemetry. Rachel you own router + console compat flag.

josh: I'll add a pre-rollout smoke: call `/v1/health/kv-check` via API with `x-runtime-variant:v10` and assert key parity across old/new runtimes. Script: `infra/smoke/kv-parity.sh --header x-runtime-variant:v10`

rachel: I'll flip `allow-legacy-headers` to true on router wave start and set a 30m timer to evaluate. If no header drops, we'll disable preserve after 30m.

marina: Pinning notes: For the router change we should pin API to old router routes until router at 25% and header-preserve validated. Use `route-pin` tag in deploybot.

josh: Agree. Also recommend setting the runtime change to 1% initial canary to watch kernel selector behavior. If kernel selector picks quantized kernels unexpectedly, have rollback ready.

release-bot: Draft release note (embargo until 05:00 UTC): "Rolling out router split for finer routing, runtime kernel and quantization improvements for lower p95, and API minor tweaks for header gating. Console gets improved routing visibility."

marina: Security/process: keep change window + release notes embargoed until +30m after final wave. Notify compliance before public release.

josh: One more: confirm the router will not rewrite `x-runtime-variant`. If it might, set preserve flag and test via `curl -H 'x-runtime-variant: v10'` to backend.

rachel: Router will not rewrite, but our sidecars might normalize headers. I'll add a sidecar exemption for the canary slice.

deploy-bot: Observability hooks attached: api latency p50/p95/p99, 4xx/5xx rates, router header-drop counter, runtime kernel metrics (OOMs, temp), console error rate. Auto-pause on thresholds; manual rollback still required to revert.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook snippet:
1) If API p95 > 1s and 5xx rising -> pause API wave, rollback API.
2) If router header_drop spikes -> pause router wave, enable `allow-legacy-headers`, rollback if persists.
3) If runtime kernel OOMs -> rollback runtime immediately.
4) If console JS errors spike -> hold rollout, flip feature flag off.

marina: All right final: order -> API -> Router -> Runtime -> Console. Pin router behind API until router at 25% and header-preserve validated. Rollback reverse. Embargo until 05:00 UTC. Everyone ack.

josh: ack. I'll be watching kernel metrics and have `deployctl rollback runtime` ready.

rachel: ack. I'll prepare the sidecar exemption and monitor header metrics.

deploy-bot: wave-1 started 03:30 UTC — api canary 2%

deploy-bot: wave-1 steady at 2% for 15m, moving to 10%

(continue in runbook channel)
